12.08.2025 CLR No.137 of 2024
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
The proposed Revision has been by 
the defendant under Section 25 of the 
Provincial Small Cause Courts, 1887 
against the judgment and decree dated 
18.07.2024, passed by learned Judge, 
Small Causes Court/IIIrd Additional
District Judge, Haridwar in SCC Suit 
No.14 of 2021, whereby the learned 
Judge has decreed the suit for 
possession and mesne profits.
2. According to the proposed 
revisionist-defendant, the rent was 
received by the respondent-plaintiff from 
the revisionist after sending the quit 
notice dated 03.04.2021.
3. The proposed Revision has been 
filed along with an Application to 
condone the delay of 76 days. 
4. Heard Mr. Bhupendra Singh Bohra, 
learned counsel holding brief of Mr. 
Shubhang Dobhal, learned counsel for 
the proposed revisionist. 
5. Notice is being issued to the 
respondent on the Delay Condonation  Application (IA No.2 of 2024). Steps to 
be taken within a week, as prayed. 
6. List on 15.10.2025 for hearing on 
the Delay Condonation Application. 
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J.)
